defect.reproducer: turtlesim remained in ROS_DOMAIN_ID=16 while teleop and observer were restarted in ROS_DOMAIN_ID=17; /turtlesim disappeared from the observed graph and reading /turtle1/pose timed out with exit=124
defect.root_cause: ROS 2 participants in different ROS_DOMAIN_ID values are isolated from each other during discovery, so teleop and the observer in domain 17 could not discover turtlesim in domain 16
defect.proof_after: teleop and observer were restarted with ROS_DOMAIN_ID=16; both /teleop_turtle and /turtlesim became visible again and the same pose read completed with exit=0
